title: Make transcriptomic analyses more pleasant
text: BadranSeq provides publication-ready visualization tools single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-Seq) data, built native ggplot2 consistent, beautiful defaults.

title: Make transcriptomic analyses more pleasant
text: ’ve ever spent time customizing Seurat plots publication, know pain: BadranSeq lightweight (native ggplot2, heavy dependencies) opinionated (sensible defaults can focus biology, aesthetics).

text: ’s better: Provides interactive GUI selecting cells embeddings brush selection, additive/subtractive selection, returns either cell names subsetted Seurat object. title: Make transcriptomic analyses more pleasant
text: Core (automatically installed): - ggplot2 - plotting - Seurat - scRNA-seq data structures - colorspace - color palette generation - magrittr - pipe operator Suggested (install full functionality): - patchwork - combining split.panels - ggrastr - rasterization large datasets - shiny - interactive cell selection - sleepwalk - interactive distance exploration

title: Make transcriptomic analyses more pleasant
text: BadranSeq’s aesthetic approach heavily inspired SCpubr Enrique Blanco Carmona. Key design elements adopted SCpubr include: Cell border visualization clarity Color palette generation using colorspace Clean, minimal theme styling silhouette approach split.comparisons BadranSeq differs providing lighter-weight, native ggplot2 implementation without SCpubr dependency, adding features like automatic PCA variance labels. need SCpubr’s full feature set (dozens specialized plot types), use SCpubr. want core aesthetics minimal dependencies, use BadranSeq.
